metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Supraspinatus Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe explains the supraspinatus muscle, often referred to as the "rotator cuff pain muscle."

If you’re experiencing shoulder pain—especially when raising your arm out to the side—and suspect a rotator cuff injury, this video is a must-watch.

A common cause of this pain is the supraspinatus muscle becoming tight and weak over time, which can lead to strain and discomfort.

This video demonstrates simple exercises to help loosen and strengthen the supraspinatus (along with the supporting rotator cuff muscles), providing both quick and lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently, so for the best results, try them all and continue using the ones that bring you the most relief.

Watch now to get instant supraspinatus and rotator cuff pain relief!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:59 Pendulum Swings
3:32 Shoulder Rotations
5:44 Shoulder Clocks
7:53 Doorframe Press 
9:53 Daily Strengthening Exercise
